newsitem.title: USA: Alltel sees good, not spectacular, '97 growth.
newsitem.headline: Alltel sees good, not spectacular, '97 growth.

text.p: Alltel Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Joe Ford said he expects the company to show "good but not spectacular" growth in 1997.

"Real growth will come in wireline, wireless and information technology. It will be good, but not spectacular," Ford told Reuters after the company's annual meeting of shareholders in Little Rock, Arkansas.
Ford also said he was "comfortable" with analysts' expectations that Alltel would report second-quarter earnings of about $0.53.
Chief Financial Officer Dennis Ferra declined to project earnings for the full year but said analysts were currently downgrading their 1997 per share estimates by a couple of cents to about $2.09.
Ford said 1997 capital expenditures would total about $550 million.
The company earlier announced it was doubling the size of its share repurchase program to 7.0 million shares. It recently completed repurchase of the 3.5 million shares authorized last October.
